verdict.rationale: Penpot's own marketing documents an inspect capability that yields code in open standards (CSS, HTML, SVG, JSON), which covers the code-snippet part of the story. The pack has no detail on layer measurements, style or asset extraction, iOS/Android snippets, or developer access without an editor seat. Missing for 10: documented layer measurements and style/asset inspection, iOS/Android code snippets, evidence of view-only or seat-free developer access, in-depth inspect-mode docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect any layer and get measurements, styles, assets, and code snippets (CSS/iOS/Android) without an editor seat

citations.quote: Inspect and integrate code that actually matches design. Enjoy open standards like CSS, HTML, SVG and JSON as well as Penpot's open file format.
